_notes.source: astroloot.jar (build 2026-09-25), decoded with javap. Internal code names kept; rename for our game.
_notes.quality q: q = quality ordinal 0..10 (Scrap=0 ... Eternal=10). Divisor is 11, so the second number is never quite reached at Eternal.
_notes.stat I: damage effectiveness multiplier: shown/used base damage = round(base * I). Default 1.0.
_notes.stat ay: base hit damage: [slot, ?, min, max, element(, flag)]. Values are before stat I. Flag 1 seems to mark continuous (beam/DoT) damage.
_notes.D:ATTACKS_PER_SECOND: base attack rate. Weapons without D attack on their own timing (mines, beams).
_notes.cz/U/cU/b: implicit pierce count / chain count / split count / additional attacks, often per quality.
_notes.an/K/cM/cD: implicit debris / blind / shock / radiation chance as a fraction.
_notes.ct/o/p: AoE damage in radius / range / arc.
_notes.unique_affixes: A.a(Affix, roll) = the unique always rolls this affix tier; see affixes.json for the value range. Numbers listed after are extra constants (weights or ranges) used by the unique.
_notes.not decoded: Projectile speed and projectile count are set inside each weapon's fire routine (code, not tables) and are not extracted. Mod-slot counts are rolled per item (affixes.json OneSlot..SixSlots weights), not fixed per base.
_notes.ax/aB/aC: base Armor / Deflector Shield / Dodge [slot, 0, value].
_notes.G:THRUST, H:MAXIMUM_VELOCITY: engine movement stats shared by all engines (engine_shared_stats).
_notes.ag: engine dash cost object ag(1.0,false): probably 1 dash charge per use (not fully decoded).
_notes.cG: nexus implicit (value range per quality, element given) - label not decoded, likely elemental resistance or damage
